_comment: Which release updates which catalog entry. Read by bump.py, which
the workflow catalog-bump runs when a release workflow below finishes and
each hour: when the newest release of a row is newer than its entry, it
opens a pull request that lists it.
repo: where the release and its zip are. tagPrefix: the tag is this
followed by the version. asset: the zip's name, {version} filled in.
uploader: the only account whose upload of the zip and its .sha256 is
listed (the release workflow's; checked on the real releases 2026-10-16).
universal: the tool's program must hold x86_64 and arm64, as it has.
releaseWorkflow: the name of the workflow in this repository that uploads
the zip; catalog-bump starts when it finishes. Only for a tool released
from this repository: one released elsewhere is picked up each hour.
//catalog:release_trigger_test fails when a row released from here has
none, or when catalog-bump's workflow_run list differs from this column.
manual: entries that are only ever changed by hand, and why.
//catalog:bump_test fails when an entry is in neither list.

manual.dev.vitruvian.reference: Attached to a release of the SDK whose tag is the SDK's version, not the tool's.
